successor_representation.name: ROUTING_ASSURANCE_SUBJECT_V1
successor_representation.mechanism_neutrality: The successor consumes structured semantic routing facts. It does not consume docs/current_routing.json, CURRENT_STATE.md, checkpoint filenames, or current oracle output strings as its target representation.

claims.statement: A compatibility source must translate into one well-formed successor routing subject before semantic qualification; malformed legacy carriers fail translation visibly.
The active routed checkpoint must exist in the represented repository checkpoint set.
When the checked line is the declared active development line, active checkpoint equals the maximum available checkpoint; an unrelated checked line does not manufacture active-line staleness.

Any independently supplied human/orientation projection of overlapping routing facts must agree semantically with canonical structured routing facts. A future generated orientation may be derived from the same canonical facts and therefore need not preserve manual Markdown synchronization.
The routing boundary must be explicitly classified as stable semantic identity rather than transition-volatile checkpoint/research/date identity.
The promoted integration revision must be one complete Git commit identity with explicit revision kind.
Declared active line, checked line and integration line identities must be non-empty bounded identifiers, and active PR must be null or a positive integer.
warrant_basis: Current routing manifest semantic type/identity checks

claims.statement: Latest specification identity must remain a zero-padded three-digit identifier and latest experiment outcome must remain non-empty semantic status.
warrant_basis: Current routing manifest semantic type/identity checks

intentional_mechanism_differences: No preservation of the legacy nine-key docs/current_routing.json object shape.
No preservation of Markdown fragment matching as the target consistency mechanism.
No preservation of current_boundary regex as the target semantic model; compatibility translation classifies stability explicitly.
No preservation of old oracle stdout wording or distinction between process return codes 1 and 2.
No preservation of checkpoint filename scanning as the target input mechanism; available checkpoint identities are explicit successor facts.
classification_parity_requirement: All 11 frozen corpus GOOD/BAD dispositions must match the old-oracle baseline. There are no preregistered accept/reject differences for the frozen corpus.

translated_representation_case.requirement: Materialize the same routing semantics directly as ROUTING_ASSURANCE_SUBJECT_V1 without legacy file paths or Markdown and require successor PASS.
translated_representation_case.negative_control: Change direct subject active_checkpoint from 269 to 268 while checked_line equals declared_active_line and available_checkpoints still include 269; successor must FAIL.

successor_independence_controls: Successor classifier may not execute or import scripts/check_current_routing.py.
Successor classifier may not read docs/current_routing.json or docs/CURRENT_STATE.md.
Legacy-to-successor translation is a compatibility adapter and must be separate from successor semantic classification.
Classifier must return structured violated claim IDs, not clone old oracle output text.
pass_criteria: Frozen old-oracle replay remains 11/11 against the corpus.
Successor accepts every frozen GOOD case.
Successor rejects every frozen BAD case.
Direct translated representation of PD4-C02 passes without legacy carrier access.
Direct stale translated negative control fails PD4-SR3.
No unique frozen invariant requires retaining the legacy carrier/output mechanism.
All four preregistered successor-only semantic-completeness controls fail with their expected claim ID.
No thresholds or semantic labels change after successor execution.
amendment_reason: Pre-implementation completeness review found that V01 represented active_pr only in the orientation projection and did not explicitly preserve several current-oracle semantic well-formedness checks. No successor implementation or result existed. V02 completes the semantic mapping before code.

successor_only_preregistered_controls.mutation: Set active_pr to 0 in a direct valid successor subject.
Set declared_active_line to a value containing spaces in a direct valid successor subject.
Set latest_specification to '28' in a direct valid successor subject.
Set latest_experiment_outcome to an empty string in a direct valid successor subject.
